page.overview:
Who is Jura?

After Code successfully had Amado Sanzu remove his limiters, Code used his Claw Marks to fragment Kara's Ten-Tails into Claw Grimes to create his own personal army. Unbeknownst to Code, the remains of the Ten-Tails eventually turned into Jura.

Jura assumes leadership of the group of self-aware Human God Trees and offers them guidance, advice, and encouragement, as well as generally speaking on their behalf. He has a calm and casual demeanour, rarely losing his composure. A philosophical and outspoken man, Jura believes that people are slaves to their emotions and can easily lose their direction with new developments. However, he soon comes to be fascinated by them, noting their aid for one's growth. He is also very observant and analytical, able to quickly deduce the mechanics behind an opponent's technique. Likewise, while still finding the concept of emotions strange, he is able to read a person's demeanour to see their true nature.

He appears very invested in learning and understand the world, both how human think and general flow of events. This also makes him quite a bookworm, enjoying reading various books to learn as much as he can, and likewise, makes a point of researching people he views as important. Also, he treasures libraries, not wanting them to be harmed. While by nature amoral and indifferent to how his actions affect others, he is not by nature confrontational preferring to avoid battling people and offering them a chance to leave him to his own goals. Likewise, he is ethical enough to pay money for obtaining things he desires. He also developed a fondness for sweets leisurely strolls. However, once he does engage in battle, he is utterly merciless. Noticeably, he seems to respect people who show drive and commitment to their own views. Likewise, he overall is very respectful in the way he talks to others and enjoys conversations to better learn. Ultimately, Jura has also come to develop a level of attachment to certain people close to him, particularly enjoying Hidari's company.

His feelings are stimulated by thoughts of Naruto Uzumaki, who he chooses as the target he wishes to devour in the belief it will let him grow to better understand his own existance. He believes the knowledge of the Thorn Soul Bulb is too vital for outsiders like Boruto to know of, and would make it a priority to eliminate such people to preserve his team's agenda, only sparing Boruto after realising that the young man only knew due to an accomplice as opposed to finding the knowledge on his own.
